newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya creates new parliament constituencies.
newsitem.headline: Kenya creates new parliament constituencies.

text.p: Kenya's National Electoral Commission has created 22 new constituencies, bringing the number of contestable seats in Kenya's parliament to 210.
The changes will bring the total number of parliamentarians after the next election to 224 -- including 12 nominated by the president, the attorney-general and the parliament speaker.
Commission chairman Zacchaeus Chesoni confirmed the changes on Wednesday, when his tenure on the commission ended. It was not immediately known when a new commission would be appointed.

The commission is appointed by the president. Chesoni's group has been accused by opposition groups of favouring Moi's ruling KANU party and they want a commission on which their supporters will be represented.
